_about: Variation across generations (List 35, #342): the generational layer of raised variation. A distinctively-raised parent's offspring starts with a LEAN — a bounded bias in its #337 drift derivation. The lean is computed at read time from the parents' settled drift facts and is NEVER written to the offspring's record (deliberate contrast with #204: inherited moves are birth facts written at hatch; a lean is a reading of two records — derived at read, never stored, per #14/#96's law).
familyLook: a lineage raised one way for generations shows a HOUSE STYLE (lean refreshed by like raising + each generation's own drift). Named as the candidate mechanism behind regional house styles, read beside #198's regional views: a regional look must trace to raising culture through this spec, NEVER to a minted regional form — forms are #40/#205's axis; a house style is a resemblance, a form is anatomy
fences: #80: deviations are NEVER inherited (a ruling is about a person, not a gene) — a channel that would echo a trait under ruling reads zero lean
#204: the move-inheritance path is untouched and separate (its absolute signature bar stands); the two systems share a hatch and nothing else
#324 (cited by commissioned subject — List 33 mid-build): species anatomy reasserts at evolution — no lean survives a stage boundary except as re-derived
#337: the lean biases envelope-bound channels only, so every leaned read passes the envelope test by construction

lean.bound: at most ONE class-step in any channel, and only in channels the parents' settled drift AGREES in — a lean, never a look; family resemblance, visible once you know the parents
lean.decay: weight fades as the offspring's own #338 facts accrue (recency weighting works against it from the first meal); sustained by like raising it never grows past its bound on its own
lean.seat: a derivation input at the offspring's read time, sourced from the parents' settled drift classes (#337/#293 growth-moment facts) while those records stand
lean.source: parents' SETTLED drift only — live unsettled drift does not lean a child

wildLines: unknown parents read lean-less (absence is not lineage, #338's rule); a wild population's shared look is read via #214/#346's wild-facts route (territory and weather raising in parallel), not by parentage
